description: This file defines the class `EmailsControllerActionGetFromFields`, which handles the logic for retrieving 'From' email address options for email composition and outbound email accounts in the SuiteCRM email module. It includes methods for processing user preferences, signatures, and accounts to generate JSON data for frontend consumption.

classes.name: EmailsControllerActionGetFromFields
classes.description: Controller class that manages fetching 'From' email address options for email composition, including user signatures, accounts, and related preferences.

methods.name: handleActionGetFromFields
methods.description: Retrieves email addresses and signatures for composing a new email, returning data as JSON encoded in ISO-8859-1.

methods.name: getOutboundFromFields
methods.description: Fetches outbound email addresses for 'From' fields, returning JSON data, including system accounts.

methods.name: getEmailSignatures
methods.description: Decodes and unserializes user signature preferences.

methods.name: getDefaultSignatures
methods.description: Provides default signature data if user signatures are not available.

methods.name: addOutboundEmailAccounts
methods.description: Adds configured outbound email accounts to the list of available 'From' addresses, including account details and signatures.
